summary: Short kerb backing onto bush, but at a junction mouth with homes 15m opposite.

best_section.where: South kerb of Carmody Road just east of the side-street junction, in front of the treed bank

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees on own side; houses 15-20m opposite across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane with one car parked in QLD image; short, close to two junctions.
drivers.convention: One car parked in 2022 image, none in 2025; 2P resident-permit sign here.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the bank to the south; shaded from the south and west.
